description: Source code for the TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI class, part of the OrangeHRM HRM system. This class provides API endpoints for managing termination reasons within the PIM (Personnel Information Management) module, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting termination reasons.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI
classes.description: Provides REST API endpoints for managing termination reason configurations, including CRUD operations and validations.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the TerminationReasonConfigurationService instance used for business logic.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all termination reasons with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing all termination reasons.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new termination reason.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Persists a TerminationReason entity with data obtained from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a termination reason, primarily validating the 'name' parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove termination reasons based on provided IDs, ensuring they are not in use.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deletion, ensuring IDs are positive and not in use.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a specific termination reason by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single termination reason by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing termination reason by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a termination reason, including uniqueness of the name.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' parameter, ensuring it is required, a string, within max length, and unique.
